# er7-rust

> A Cargo workspace of three independently-versioned Rust crates for HL7® v2 integration in the ER7 pipe-hat encoding — er7 (the encoding itself, zero dependencies), er7-redact (removes patient detail without changing shape), and serde-er7 (Serde support for the value tree).

This file curates the workspace's own files, with repo-relative links —
`AGENTS.md`, `spec/index.md`, and the like — that resolve only inside a
clone or checkout of this repository, not as URLs. For the same content
addressed by absolute URL, so it resolves from anywhere, see the
published site's own map at <https://er7-rust.github.io/llms.txt>.

None of the three crates include a data-type dictionary, message-structure
grammars, or validation — that is a deliberate layer above, built by the
sibling `hl7-rust` project. Absent, empty, and explicit null are three
different facts a field can carry, and collapsing them is the most common
way integration code corrupts a clinical record — read `er7/index.md`
before writing code against any of these crates.

HL7®, and FHIR® are the registered trademarks of Health Level Seven
International and their use of these trademarks does not constitute an
endorsement by HL7.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): The workspace-root agent entry point — the three-crate layout, the non-crate directories, and where workspace-level policy lives.
- [index.md](index.md): The workspace README — install, building, the project-document map, license.
- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): The workspace-level specification: what is genuinely shared across all three crates, and what belongs in a crate's own spec instead.
- [plan.md](plan.md): The professionalization workstreams and where the workspace stands.
- [tasks.md](tasks.md): The verified-done execution checklist for workspace-level work.

## Crates

- [er7/index.md](er7/index.md): Parse, query, edit, and write HL7 v2 messages in the ER7 pipe-hat encoding, with zero dependencies.
- [er7/AGENTS.md](er7/AGENTS.md): Agent entry point for er7 — the rules that bind every change, and the documentation map.
- [er7/spec/index.md](er7/spec/index.md): er7's own specification: the rule index (R1-R27), roadmap, and open tasks.
- [er7-redact/index.md](er7-redact/index.md): Redact patient detail from an ER7 message without changing its shape.
- [er7-redact/AGENTS.md](er7-redact/AGENTS.md): Agent entry point for er7-redact.
- [er7-redact/spec/index.md](er7-redact/spec/index.md): er7-redact's own specification: policies, actions, pseudonyms, the rule index (D1-D24).
- [serde-er7/index.md](serde-er7/index.md): Serialize and deserialize ER7 message trees with Serde.
- [serde-er7/AGENTS.md](serde-er7/AGENTS.md): Agent entry point for serde-er7.
- [serde-er7/spec/index.md](serde-er7/spec/index.md): serde-er7's own specification: the wire shape per level, the rule index (S1-S12).

## Agent skills

- [er7-skill/SKILL.md](er7-skill/SKILL.md): A packaged Claude Code Skill teaching an AI coding agent how to use these crates as a dependency — concepts, terminology, which crate to reach for, and worked recipes.
- [er7-rust-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md](er7-rust-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md): The companion skill for changing this repository itself — spec-driven development, the four checks, the safety rules.
